### Features
- **AppSec:** RFC-1103 normalized HTTP route tag for Express [#8857](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/8857)
- **General:** Add awaited context callbacks to conditional branches [#9678](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9678)
- **General:** Configure server error statuses [#9638](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9638)
- **LLM Observability:** Accept image_parts on messages [#9684](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9684)
- **LLM Observability:** Resolve and propagate agent attribution [#9175](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9175)
- **mysql, mysql2:** Trace pool connection acquisition [#8920](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/8920)
- **Test Optimization:** Optimize WebdriverIO Jasmine tests [#9668](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9668)

### Fixes
- **datastreams:** Start a new pathway for a message that carries no context [#9575](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9575)
- **kafka:** Preserve application headers on native produce path [#9595](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9595)
- **openai-agents:** Preserve structural span ancestry [#9674](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9674)
- **Test Optimization:** Defer Vitest EFD faultiness detection [#9700](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9700)
- **Test Optimization:** Escape Vitest browser provided context [#9730](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9730)

### Internal (CI, Testing, Benchmarking)
- **aws-sdk:** Stabilize DynamoDB trace assertions [#9675](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9675)
- **Dependencies:** Bump mocha [#9710](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9710)
- **Dependencies:** Bump openai [#9725](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9725)
- **General:** Update one-pipeline to 1.2.0 [#9718](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9718)
- **Test Optimization:** Avoid duplicate WebdriverIO fixture copy [#9731](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9731)
- **Test Optimization:** Move Jest test utilities [#9713](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9713)
- **Test Optimization:** Stabilize output file limit test [#9702](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9702)
